name: USCG-based Sp-MART
definition: A reconstruction method that reduces space and time complexity of algebraic methods by using a Uniformly Sampled Polar Grid (USPG) or Uniformly Sampled Cylindrical Grid (USCG) discretization scheme, solving the issue of radial deterioration of resolution found in conventional polar grid methods.
summary: USCG-based Sp-MART is a tomographic reconstruction method that reduces space and time complexity by using a Uniformly Sampled Cylindrical Grid to solve radial resolution deterioration and accelerate line tracing.
